changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_lead_workflow_details_gin ON n_lead USING GIN (workflow_details);
COMMENT ON INDEX idx_n_lead_workflow_details_gin IS 'GIN index on n_lead.workflow_details JSONB column for improved performance on workflow/stage filtering queries in dashboard';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_lead_onhold_details_gin ON n_lead USING GIN (onhold_details);
COMMENT ON INDEX idx_n_lead_onhold_details_gin IS 'GIN index on n_lead.onhold_details JSONB column for improved performance on onHold date filtering queries';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_lead_reasons_gin ON n_lead USING GIN (reasons);
COMMENT ON INDEX idx_n_lead_reasons_gin IS 'GIN index on n_lead.reasons JSONB column for improved performance on reason filtering queries';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_lead_other_details_gin ON n_lead USING GIN (other_details);
COMMENT ON INDEX idx_n_lead_other_details_gin IS 'GIN index on n_lead.other_details JSONB column for improved performance on other_details filtering queries';
